xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5107: Phone app: delete your account from Settings (App Review 5.1.1(v), Play account-deletion policy)

plan.title: Phone app: delete your account from Settings (App Review 5.1.1(v), Play account-deletion policy)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One vertical feature in apps/mobile (one new module, two screens, one wiring point) plus its docs; 15 files, 3 subsystems (mobile app, account-service test, docs).

narratives.Problem: Signing in to the phone app creates an overdeck.ai account, and App Review Guideline 5.1.1(v) and Google Play's account-deletion policy require deleting that account from inside the app. The phone app has no way to do it, so the iPhone build cannot go to App Review. The server route DELETE /v1/account already exists.
narratives.Proposal: Add a Delete account button and a type-DELETE confirm dialog to the phone Settings screen. Confirming calls DELETE ${ACCOUNT_BASE_URL}/v1/account with the device token through CapacitorHttp. On 202 (or 401 account_deleted) the app runs the existing sign-out cleanup with account: null, which skips the device revoke step, and the sign-in screen shows 'Your account is being deleted.' through a sessionStorage notice that survives the reload. On other 401 or 403 it runs the same cleanup and tells the user to finish on the web. On a network error or any other status it stays signed in and offers Delete on the web (Browser.open of ${ACCOUNT_BASE_URL}/account). The deletion copy is duplicated in a no-import mobile module and pinned equal to the account page's by a root test. Docs: RELEASE.md, README.md, configuration/phone.mdx, changelog.mdx Upcoming block, and apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-5107.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to any file under services/account/src and no Worker deploy
- No mobile version bump, build, TestFlight upload or store submission
- No GitHub-login prompt in the phone confirm step
- No change to signOut.ts behavior or to the normal Sign out flow
- No new section in apps/mobile/ACCEPTANCE.md

autoDecisions.summary: Duplicate DELETE_STATEMENT and DELETION_STARTED_MESSAGE in apps/mobile/src/shell/accountDeletionCopy.ts and pin them with a root parity test instead of sharing through @overdeck/contracts.
autoDecisions.rationale: services/account has no contracts dependency; sharing would change Worker source, which the issue forbids (no Worker change, deploys are operator-only).

autoDecisions.summary: Skip the revoke step by calling signOut({ ...cleanup, account: null }); signOut.ts is unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: signOut uses account only for the revoke step, and the server already revoked every device; a test with the real signOut asserts DELETE /v1/devices is never called.

autoDecisions.summary: Carry the signed-out notice across the cleanup reload in sessionStorage key overdeck.signedOutNotice.
autoDecisions.rationale: The cleanup clears localStorage and reloads; sessionStorage survives the reload and ShellApp already relies on that for LAUNCH_URL_KEY.

autoDecisions.summary: Map 401 with error account_deleted to the same 'being deleted' outcome as 202.
autoDecisions.rationale: lookupDevice answers account_deleted while a deletion job is open, so this is a retry after a lost 202; telling the user to finish on the web would be wrong.

autoDecisions.summary: Confirm requires exactly DELETE after trim (case-sensitive), with autoCapitalize characters and autocorrect off.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says type DELETE; the input attributes make phone keyboards produce capitals.

autoDecisions.summary: Write acceptance evidence to apps/mobile/acceptance/PAN-5107.md instead of adding a line to ACCEPTANCE.md.
autoDecisions.rationale: ACCEPTANCE.md and README.md say new evidence goes in acceptance/PAN-<n>.md and nobody adds to ACCEPTANCE.md (PAN-5054 conflicts).

autoDecisions.summary: Create a v0.76.0 Upcoming block in changelog.mdx in the historical shape.
autoDecisions.rationale: The top block is the released v0.75.0; the issue says create the block when missing; docs/RELEASING.md defines its shape.

autoDecisions.summary: 15 s connect and read timeouts on the DELETE request.
autoDecisions.rationale: A hung request must become a visible error with the web fallback, not an endless Deleting state.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create apps/mobile/src/shell/accountDeletion.ts exporting DELETE_ACCOUNT_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000, SIGNED_OUT_NOTICE_KEY = 'overdeck.signedOutNotice', types SignedOutNotice ('deletion-requested' | 'finish-on-web'), DeletionAnswer ('requested' | 'token-gone'), DeleteAccountResult ({ ok: true } | { ok: false; message: string }), DeleteAccountDeps { account; cleanup: SignOutDeps; request?; setNotice? }, and functions requestAccountDeletion(account), deleteAccount(deps), writeSignedOutNotice, readSignedOutNotice (returns only the two known values, else null), clearSignedOutNotice (all sessionStorage calls in try/catch), openAccountPage() = Browser.open({ url: `${ACCOUNT_BASE_URL}/account` }). requestAccountDeletion: CapacitorHttp.request DELETE `${ACCOUNT_BASE_URL}/v1/account`, Authorization Bearer account.token, connectTimeout and readTimeout DELETE_ACCOUNT_TIMEOUT_MS; 202 -> 'requested'; 401 whose body error (response.data as object OR JSON string; unreadable = no code) is 'account_deleted' -> 'requested'; other 401 and 403 -> 'token-gone'; any other status throws Error(`overdeck.ai answered HTTP ${status}.`); rejection propagates. deleteAccount: on a thrown request return { ok: false, message } and run nothing; otherwise setNotice('deletion-requested' for requested, 'finish-on-web' for token-gone), then await signOut({ ...deps.cleanup, account: null }) and return { ok: true }. Do not change signOut.ts. Tests mock @capacitor/core and @capacitor/browser like signIn.test.ts lines 4-11, build cleanup deps like signOut.test.ts lines 23-55, and use vi.useFakeTimers in beforeEach / vi.useRealTimers in afterEach (fake-timers repo rule).

Given mocked answers, when requestAccountDeletion runs, then tests prove 202 and 401 {error:'account_deleted'} (object and string body) return 'requested', 401 invalid_token and 403 return 'token-gone', 503 rejects with 'overdeck.ai answered HTTP 503.', and a network rejection propagates

metadata.acJustification: Six ACs: five dialog behaviors plus the optional-prop guard that keeps the tree typechecking before shellapp-wiring.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Add OPTIONAL props onDeleteAccount?: () => Promise<DeleteAccountResult> and onOpenAccountPage?: () => void to SettingsScreenProps (SettingsScreen.tsx lines 155-168), following the optional notifications?/liveActivity? rows in the same file, so ShellApp still typechecks before shellapp-wiring lands. Below the Sign out button (lines 273-283), only when onDeleteAccount is given, add a 'Delete account' button with the same classes as Sign out (text-destructive). It opens DeleteAccountDialog (same file): fixed inset-0 z-50 overlay, panel role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby its h3 'Delete your account'; then DELETE_STATEMENT, DELETE_IRREVERSIBLE, label 'Type DELETE to confirm' wrapping an input with autoCapitalize='characters' autoCorrect='off' autoComplete='off' spellCheck={false}; after a failure a role=alert paragraph `Couldn't delete your account: ${message} Try again, or delete it on the web.` plus a 'Delete on the web' button calling onOpenAccountPage; then Cancel (closes and clears) and confirm 'Delete account' enabled only when value.trim() === DELETE_CONFIRM_WORD and not busy. On confirm: busy, await onDeleteAccount(); ok:false -> show error, clear busy; ok:true -> stay busy. While busy confirm reads 'Deleting…' and confirm and Cancel are disabled. All touch targets min-h-11. Update line 1 header comment to mention PAN-5107 and update renderSettings in the test file to pass the new props.
